purpose: Fictional examples for exercising rental-scam warning signals.
important_note: Every record is synthetic. None was copied from a real listing, and none describes a real person or property. Prices and locations are fictional test values, not market data. These examples are not evidence of fraud and are not a validated training dataset.

records.label: suspicious
records.label_basis: fictional scenario designed to contain multiple warning signs

listing.title: Two-bedroom apartment, quick move-in
listing.description: Fictional test listing. Send a deposit before viewing to reserve the apartment. E-transfer only. Send deposit today because many people are interested.

manual_review_signals: Verify the unit and rental authority before paying; the low fictional price alone does not prove fraud.

listing.title: Furnished one-bedroom, available now
listing.description: Fictional test listing. I am overseas and cannot meet for a viewing. The keys will be shipped after you send a wire transfer deposit before viewing.

manual_review_signals: Request an in-person or live video viewing and independently confirm who is authorized to rent the unit.

listing.title: Studio viewing appointment
listing.description: Fictional test listing. Before I schedule the showing, tell me the six-digit Facebook verification code sent to your phone. Act now so I can hold your place.

manual_review_signals: Never share login or verification codes with a prospective landlord.

listing.title: Bright two-bedroom suite
listing.description: Fictional test listing. I cannot meet because I am out of the country. Send the deposit before viewing and I will arrange delivery of the keys.

manual_review_signals: Compare the synthetic photo fixture with other test listings to exercise duplicate-image detection.
A repeated photo is a reason to investigate, not proof by itself that an ad is fraudulent.

listing.title: Vancouver one-bedroom apartment
listing.description: Fictional test listing. The title says Vancouver, but the description says the unit is in Surrey. First come first served; send deposit today to hold it.

manual_review_signals: Resolve the city mismatch by verifying the property location independently.
The current text rules do not automatically flag this location contradiction.
